name: Forgotten Loa Idols

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, communion with the loa is central to your spiritual life. Lost idols let vital rituals continue and help keep the tribe in the spirits’ good graces.
As a troll priest, you rely on rituals and sacred items from your ancestors to channel spiritual power and honor the loa.
As a troll shaman, you invoke elemental forces while honoring the wild gods and ancestral loa tied to your tribe’s survival.
As a member of the Horde, you belong to a faction whose foundational members include the Darkspear. Helping their holy elders preserve vital religious artifacts strengthens tribal unity.

faq.answer: The Darkspear need the missing sacred idols so their tribal rituals can resume and they can honor their wild spirits.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Forgotten Loa Idols?

faq.answer: The loa are powerful, ancient primal spirits and animal deities revered by trolls. Trolls honor them with offerings, prayer, and ritual ceremonies, seeking protection, favor, and spiritual guidance.
The Darkspear meet the loa with deep reverence, mutual respect, and a sense of spiritual duty. They believe their survival depends on keeping the spirits’ favor.
faq.q: How do the Darkspear view their loa compared to other troll tribes?

faq.answer: The idols are sacred objects needed for tribal rites. Without them, elders and spiritual leaders cannot properly commune with and honor their patron spirits.
faq.q: Why are the idols needed for tribal rituals?

faq.answer: The Darkspear fear that without proper rites and offerings, they could lose the loa’s favor and protection, leaving the tribe vulnerable in a perilous world.
faq.q: Why is keeping the loa's favor so vital to the Darkspear?

faq.answer: A Darkspear spiritual guide seeks the idols’ return and is anxious to resume communal ceremonies and secure blessings from the tribe’s ancestral patrons.
faq.q: Who seeks the return of the Forgotten Loa Idols?

sections.body: The Darkspear honor the loa through sacred rites. These primal animal spirits and wild gods belong to the trolls’ ancestral heritage. The lost idols are needed for ceremonies in their honor. Without them, spiritual leaders cannot perform the rites that keep the tribe in harmony with its divine guardians.
sections.title: Sacred Remnants of the Loa

sections.body: The Darkspear approach the loa with respect and humble reverence. Other hostile troll factions across Azeroth practice blood sacrifice or try to command spirits by force. Losing their patrons’ favor would be a grave catastrophe for the Darkspear. So restoring the idols is vital to preserving the tribe.
sections.title: The Darkspear Bond

summary: The Darkspear seek the Forgotten Loa Idols so their sacred rites can continue. The relics preserve the tribe’s bond with its patron spirits.
